items.title: v2.1.307
items.summary: What's changed Added /claude-api api-version to move Claude API code to API version 2026-10-21 Added the claude_code.safety_event OpenTelemetry event for each tool call a permission rule, auto mode, a safety check, a hook or the sandbox stopped, prompted or sent back Fixed requests failing with a model-not-found error when CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT is set and the model is an alias with the [1m] suffix, such as opus[1m] Fixed the prompt-caching-scope beta header being sent behind custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL gateways and on Foundry, where it has no effect Fixed MCP servers showing "needs auth

items.title: v2.1.306
items.summary: What's changed Fixed claude -p inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools

items.title: v2.1.305
items.summary: What's changed Added sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections Added CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS so unattended retry mode ( CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG ) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its reset Fixed every request failing on Vertex, Bedrock and other providers when the endpoint or a gateway rejects tool search, and behind gateways with ToolSearch disallowed or left out of --tools (a 2.1.304 regression): Claude Code now retri

items.title: v2.1.304
items.summary: What's changed Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin Added decider: "person" to a mod's tool.check answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask, and it is refused with the mod's reason where nobody can be asked Added e.isReadOnly to a mod's tool.check event, set when the tool call is read-only Added /auto-mode-setup : a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your environment, now also available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude apps gateway
